operator_quote: Okay, until I actually start getting into this, I need uh, her to just start throwing shit on my calendar and signing me up for stuff.

command.text: Yes, he is employed full time at Expansion Capital Group, and his employer must not find out he is looking. Off limits for events: weekdays 8:00am-5:00pm Central (his workday), except that 1:00-2:30pm Central on weekdays is kept free for job interviews and should not be filled with events. Events go on weekday evenings after 5:30pm Central and on weekends; virtual events are fine at those times too.
